title: Forum
subtitle: On-chain discussion on the BitShares blockchain.
intro: Topics are posted on-chain from your account and visible to everyone. The sender pays a small network fee per post, which keeps spam out. Open a topic to read its replies.
probeUnsupported: This node does not run the custom_operations plugin, so forum history cannot be read here. Broadcasting still works from any node; choose a node with the plugin enabled in node settings to read history.
probeError: The connected node did not answer the plugin probe. Check your connection and retry.
noSupportedNode: None of the known nodes run the custom_operations plugin. Try again later, or run your own API node with custom_operations enabled.
probeUnsupportedThread: This node does not run the custom_operations plugin, so this thread cannot be read here. Broadcasting still works from any node; choose a node with the plugin enabled in node settings to read it.
topicsEmpty: No topics in {{channel}} yet — start the first one below.
hiddenTopicsDesc: Topics you hid in the forum. Hidden entries for topics that disappear from the channel results are cleared automatically.
hiddenTopicsEmptyDesc: Hide a forum topic to remove it from your topic lists.
waitingForNode: Topics appear once a supported node is selected.
channelsSubtitle: Each channel advertises its own topics. Open one to read and reply.
threadSubtitle: On-chain thread on the BitShares blockchain.
watchingEmpty: Nothing watched yet — open a thread and use Watch to follow its replies. Topics you start are watched automatically.
composerLogin: Log in to post on-chain topics.
bodyLabel: Body — the language you write in sets the topic language (max ~1500 characters)
errorEmpty: Title and body are both required.
errorTooLong: Topic is {{over}} bytes over the size limit ({{max}} bytes).
composerHintLoggedOut: Posting as {{user}} to {{catalog}} would cost a small network fee.
replyPlaceholder: Write your reply… (optional “> quoted” lines on top)
quoteHint: Quote with lines starting in “> ” — quotes are convention only and can be forged, authorship is always your account.
blockConfirmDesc: Are you sure you want to block this account? You won't see their posts anymore.
badLinkDesc: This link is missing a valid channel or thread id.
missingDesc: No topic with this id was found in this channel — check the link, or try a node with the plugin enabled.
mismatchDesc: The thread pointer does not match its author's identity hash, so it is hidden instead of rendered.
attachOfferStale: Attached offer {{label}} is no longer available on-chain.
attachHoverTitle: {{user}} has attached this {{item}} to their post.
